cohort: 176 eyes of 88 children with tearing (49 boys, 39 girls; mean age 23.81 ± 14.67 months)
finding: Dacryoscintigraphy is a non-invasive method for diagnosing nasolacrimal duct obstruction in children with tearing, effectively guiding treatment decisions and showing symptom improvement in the majority of patients.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was recorded but no findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
